items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: the same thing with Mario Brad. Mario Brad could pass forever.

ctx.x: He's had cold, cold black hair and his complexion was, well the same thing with Mario Brad. Mario Brad could pass forever.

I know white people that are proud to have played with on Matoya. He passed. You knew Matoya? No, I know people who played with him. There are plenty of white people who say, oh yeah, I've played with him.
